title: VesselProfile
description: Configuration entry defining safety thresholds and route constraints for a vessel type. §18.2, §48.5. Canonical copy lives in config/vessel_profiles.yaml (AI Service); this schema is the shared shape for any API/UI surface that displays or validates it.

thresholds.description: Three-band thresholds per factor used by the deterministic Risk baseline. §48.2, §48.5, §24.2. Each field name's suffix must match the canonical unit assigned to that parameter in shared-config/canonical-units.json — that file is the single source of truth; field names here are derived from it, not the reverse. Wind is canonically m/s (WMO/SI), hence 'wind_ms', not 'wind_kn'.

visibility_km.description: Lower is worse — direction is inverted per §48.2.

distance_from_coast_factor.description: Whether distance from coast is treated as a safety factor for this vessel type. §18.2
